guide.quickAddTitle: Quick add: get the pre-set shortcut
guide.quickAddSubtitle: Installs Log Transaction with Amount, Merchant & Card already wired — you still make the automation.

steps.1: Open the Kachingz app once after installing (this registers the action)
steps.2: Open Shortcuts → Automation tab → Create New Automation (the + icon only appears if you already have an automation)
steps.3: Scroll down and select Wallet → in the trigger options, App: Wallet (catches tap-to-pay AND online purchases)
steps.4: Select all Cards and Categories → do not filter any merchants → Select Run Immediately → Go next
steps.5: In the actions list, search "Log Transaction" → select Kachingz's action
steps.6: Automation tab → select the created automation → select "Log Transaction"
steps.7: Tap the Amount field → select Shortcut Input → tap it again → pick "Amount" (the transaction's price)
steps.8: Tap the Merchant field → select Shortcut Input → tap it again → pick "Merchant" (the store name)
steps.9: Tap the Card Name field → select Shortcut Input → tap it again → pick "Card or Pass" (the card used)
steps.10: Tap the tick (top right) to finish

guide.step3iOS26: Scroll down and select Wallet → Card: Any Card • Merchant: Any
guide.fieldHint: This picks the structured transaction fields — NOT the notification text. The "Shortcut Input → tap it again" step opens the transaction's sub-fields (Amount, Merchant, Card/Pass); selecting them directly is what makes every purchase log correctly, even when the notification preview is truncated.
guide.fieldHintFallback: If a field doesn't offer those sub-fields, you can also type the variable name: tap the field → search "Amount" → pick the transaction's Amount from the suggestions.
guide.doneLine: That's it — every purchase logs automatically, even with the phone locked. Make a purchase and the green banner above appears once it's verified.
